status: fixed before fitting or viewing model predictions
estimator: L2 logistic regression, C=0.1, lbfgs, unweighted, max_iter=3000, tol=1e-8
tuning: none; validation is diagnostic, no configuration selected from its scores
preprocessing: training-only median imputation and scaling; category/state one-hot with min_frequency=200; missing indicators are explicit and fixed
regional: 180-day purchase history with approval known strictly before first purchase; per-order category weights sum to one; national Dirichlet 0.5 per taxonomy category, state shrinkage strength 100 order-equivalents; multi-category features averaged across categories
split: initial train t0<2017-09-01; validation 2017-12-01<=t0<2018-01-01; final refit t0<2018-01-01; test t0>=2018-04-01 within audited mature cohort
features: background log1p amount/items/weight/volume/mean seller-customer distance, month sine/cosine, multi-seller, weight/dimensions/distance missing indicators, category and state; fulfillment adds log1p delivery days, late indicator, log1p late days, log1p freight/amount
uncertainty: paired 1000 customer bootstrap and 1000 state-cluster bootstrap of fixed test predictions; no model refitting; percentile 95% intervals
cases: bed_bath_table and sports_leisure, descriptive only, full audited cohort; report exact counts and Wilson intervals, no significance-driven selection
test_policy: one fixed comparison; no model changes after test inspection
